flows.name: View landing page and get started
flows.goal: Understand what personal dashboards are for and start using TidyDash.
flows.outcome: The visitor understands TidyDash and has a path to sign up or sign in; nothing is stored and refresh shows the same landing page.
flows.description: A visitor arrives on the public landing page, reads what personal dashboards are for with examples of notes, counters, checklists and link lists, sees how to start by creating a dashboard and adding widgets, and chooses to sign up or sign in to begin.

flows.name: Sign up
flows.goal: Create a new account to own private dashboards.
flows.outcome: A new account is created and the member is signed in; refresh still shows them signed in on their dashboard list.
flows.description: A new visitor chooses to sign up from the landing page, provides email and password, submits, and the website creates the account, signs them in and takes them to their dashboard list which is empty on first use.

flows.name: Sign in
flows.goal: Sign back in to access my dashboards.
flows.outcome: The member is signed in and sees their dashboard list; refresh keeps them signed in.
flows.description: A returning member chooses to sign in, enters email and password, submits, and the website verifies the credentials and shows their existing dashboards with last-edited times.

flows.name: Sign out
flows.goal: End the session so my dashboards stay private.
flows.outcome: The member is signed out; refresh shows the public landing page and dashboards are no longer visible until sign in.
flows.description: A signed-in member chooses to sign out, the website ends the session and returns them to the public landing page, hiding all private dashboards.

flows.name: View dashboard list
flows.goal: See all my dashboards and when each was last edited.
flows.outcome: No data changes; refresh still shows the same list of the member's dashboards ordered by last edited.
flows.description: A signed-in member opens their dashboard list and the website shows every dashboard they own with its name and last-edited time, most recently edited first, with options to create, open, rename, duplicate or delete.

flows.name: Create dashboard
flows.goal: Start a new empty dashboard to fill with widgets.
flows.outcome: A new dashboard named Untitled dashboard is saved and appears in the list; refresh still shows it and opening it shows an empty editor.
flows.description: A signed-in member chooses Create from the dashboard list, the website immediately creates and saves an empty dashboard named Untitled dashboard, updates its last-edited time to now, and shows it in the list and opens it in the editor for renaming and adding widgets.

flows.name: Rename dashboard
flows.goal: Give a dashboard a meaningful name.
flows.outcome: The dashboard's name is updated and its last-edited time is now; refresh shows the new name in the list and editor.
flows.description: A member chooses to rename a dashboard from the list or editor, edits its name, saves, and the website updates the name, refreshes last-edited to now with autosave confirmation, and shows the new name everywhere.

flows.name: Duplicate dashboard
flows.goal: Make a full copy of a dashboard with all its widgets.
flows.outcome: A copy named Copy of {name} with copies of all widgets is saved; refresh shows both original and copy in the list.
flows.description: A member chooses Duplicate on a dashboard, the website creates a full copy including all widgets and their contents named Copy of {name}, sets its last-edited to now, and shows it alongside the original in the list.

flows.name: Delete dashboard
flows.goal: Permanently remove a dashboard I no longer need.
flows.outcome: The dashboard and all its widgets are permanently gone; refresh still shows the list without it.
flows.description: A member chooses Delete on a dashboard, confirms the permanent removal, and the website deletes the dashboard with all its widgets and items and shows the updated list without it.

flows.name: Open dashboard in editor
flows.goal: Open a dashboard to view and change its widgets with automatic saving.
flows.outcome: No data changes by opening alone; refresh still shows the same dashboard with its saved widgets and a saved indicator.
flows.description: A member opens a dashboard from the list, the website shows the editor with the dashboard name and all its widgets in order with their titles, sizes and contents, indicates that changes save automatically, and keeps the saved state on refresh.

flows.name: Add widget
flows.goal: Add a note, counter, checklist or link-list widget to a dashboard.
preconditions: A dashboard is open in the editor.
flows.outcome: A new widget of the chosen type is appended at the end in medium size with defaults and last-edited is now; refresh shows it in place.
flows.description: A member in the editor chooses to add a widget, picks its type among note, counter, checklist and link list, sets its title, and the website appends it at the end in medium size with type defaults, updates last-edited to now with a saved indicator, and shows it ready to configure and use.

flows.name: Rename, move and resize widget
flows.goal: Arrange widgets by renaming, reordering and resizing them.
preconditions: A dashboard with at least one widget is open.
flows.outcome: Widget title, order and size are updated and last-edited is now; refresh shows the widget in its new place with new title and size.
flows.description: A member selects a widget in the editor, changes its title, moves it earlier or later relative to other widgets, switches its size between small, medium and large, and the website saves each change automatically, updates last-edited to now, and shows the widget with its new title, position and size.

flows.name: Remove widget
flows.goal: Permanently remove a widget I no longer need.
preconditions: A dashboard with at least one widget is open.
flows.outcome: The widget and its items are permanently gone and last-edited is now; refresh shows the dashboard without it.
flows.description: A member chooses to remove a widget in the editor, confirms the permanent removal, and the website deletes the widget with its checklist items or link entries, updates last-edited to now, and shows the remaining widgets in order.

flows.name: Use note widget
flows.goal: Keep plain text in a note widget.
preconditions: A dashboard with a note widget is open.
flows.outcome: Note text is saved and last-edited is now; refresh shows the same text in the note widget.
flows.description: A member edits the plain text inside a note widget, the website autosaves the text immediately, updates the dashboard last-edited to now with a saved indicator, and shows the updated text in place.

flows.name: Use counter widget
flows.goal: Track a count with a label using increase and decrease.
preconditions: A dashboard with a counter widget is open.
flows.outcome: Counter label and value are saved and last-edited is now; refresh shows the same label and value.
flows.description: A member edits the counter label and taps increase or decrease to change the value by one, including into negatives, and the website saves each change automatically, updates last-edited to now, and shows the current label and number in place.

flows.name: Use checklist widget
flows.goal: Track to-dos by adding items and ticking them off.
preconditions: A dashboard with a checklist widget is open.
flows.outcome: Checklist items and their ticked states are saved and last-edited is now; refresh shows the same items with the same ticks.
flows.description: A member adds new items with text to a checklist widget and ticks or unticks existing items, the website saves each addition and tick change immediately, updates last-edited to now, and shows the updated list with ticked states.

flows.name: Use link list widget
flows.goal: Keep titles with web addresses and open them.
preconditions: A dashboard with a link list widget is open.
flows.outcome: Link entries are saved and last-edited is now; refresh shows the same entries and choosing one opens its address in a new tab.
flows.description: A member adds entries with a title and web address to a link list widget, the website validates and saves them with https prepended when needed, updates last-edited to now, shows the entries in place, and opens the address in a new tab when the member chooses a link.

fields.label: Widget type
fields.meaning: What kind of content the widget holds

fields.label: Widget size
fields.meaning: How large the widget appears relative to other widgets

fields.meaning: Plain text kept in a note widget
